A small non-security recovery-navigation change can expose the existing enrollment form without clearing local data or credentials. It has not been implemented in this read-only diagnosis.
recovery.then: Once valid POS enrollment succeeds, retry Manager activation on the POS using the authorized code and user-entered PIN. No activation request was submitted here.
